lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.mutate_player_career(p_slot integer, p_expected_revision bigint, p_operation text, p_state jsonb)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/mutate_player_career`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

metadata.name: mutate_player_career
metadata.arguments: p_slot integer, p_expected_revision bigint, p_operation text, p_state jsonb
